record.paper_title: Norming Markushevich bases: recent results and open problems
record.original_question: Let K be a scattered Valdivia compact space that contains a copy of the ordinal interval [0,ω₁]. Is there a bounded linear extension operator from C([0,ω₁]) to C(K)? More generally, does C([0,ω₁]) embed into C(K)?

evidence.quote: Problem 5.10. Let K be a scattered Valdivia compactum that contains [0, ω1]. Is there a linear extension operator from C([0, ω1]) to C(K)? More generally, does C([0, ω1]) embed into C(K)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions. For a compact Hausdorff space L, write C(L) for the Banach space of real-valued continuous functions on L with the supremum norm. The ordinal interval [0,ω₁] is the set of ordinals up to and including the first uncountable ordinal ω₁, equipped with the order topology (a compact Hausdorff space).

A Σ-product in a product space [0,1]^Γ is the subset
  Σ([0,1]^Γ) = { x ∈ [0,1]^Γ : { γ ∈ Γ : x(γ) ≠ 0 } is countable }.
A compact Hausdorff space K is called Valdivia if, for some index set Γ, K can be embedded homeomorphically into [0,1]^Γ in such a way that K ∩ Σ([0,1]^Γ) is dense in K.

A topological space is scattered if every nonempty closed subset has an isolated point.

If L is a closed subspace of a compact Hausdorff space K, a bounded linear extension operator from C(L) to C(K) is a bounded linear map T : C(L) → C(K) such that (Tf)|_L = f for every f ∈ C(L).

Problem. Let K be a scattered Valdivia compact space that contains a homeomorphic copy of [0,ω₁] as a closed subspace.

(a) Does there exist a bounded linear extension operator from C([0,ω₁]) to C(K)?

(b) More generally, does C([0,ω₁]) embed isomorphically (as a Banach space) into C(K)?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open problem in a recent survey on norming Markushevich bases. A web search did not surface any subsequent published resolution for scattered Valdivia compacta containing [0,ω₁]. The status is therefore reported as open based on its formulation as an explicit open problem and the absence of evidence of a solution.

status_evidence.title: Automorphisms in spaces of continuous functions on Valdivia compacta
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Banach spaces C(K) with K a continuous image of Valdivia compact and related extension/embedding questions.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature on C(K) for Valdivia K does not resolve the specific scattered case with [0,ω₁].

status_evidence.title: Extension operators and twisted sums of c0 and C(K) spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies existence of bounded linear extension operators in C(K) spaces.
status_evidence.claim: General theory of extension operators does not provide a known answer for scattered Valdivia K ⊇ [0,ω₁].
